events.title: Miami Marketta Thursday Street Food & Free Live Music
events.description: A consistent weekly community gathering featuring local street food stalls and rotating live music performances in a relaxed, open-air industrial setting. It functions as a social hub for locals to connect and enjoy independent artists.

events.title: QUARTET
events.description: A local production of the play 'Quartet' performed by the Gold Coast Little Theatre community, focusing on the lives of retired opera singers. It offers a classic theatre experience in an intimate, long-running local venue.
